interpretation: Each row maps a ranked Storm sparse-model state ID to the full PRISM state-variable valuation and labels attached to that state.
limitations: Storm state IDs are internal indices for this exact parsed model, property set, builder configuration, and Storm version; they are not PRISM variable values and may change under another build.
The mapping is descriptive and does not establish that a state causes the target outcome.
Candidate scores and empirical probabilities retain the exploratory limitations documented by the candidate-extraction experiment.
Labels report only labels attached directly to the mapped state.
